Clique numa unidade sua para ver para on: Click one of your units to see where it can move and what it can reach. Click it again, or the "!" button above it, to open the unit menu (build, extract, repair, transport). Greyed-out icons explain, on hover, why they are unavailable.
Na tela de construção (Warmachine ou fáb: On the build screen (Warmachine or factory), hover the armor and weapon icons to see what the unit is strong and weak against. Infantry and the Spider Tank cross forests and mountains without losing movement.
Espaço ou Enter encerra o turno, Tab pas: Space or Enter ends the turn, Tab moves to the next unit, R repairs, B builds, E extracts, T calls transport and U undoes. Press H during a match to see them all.
O jogo salva sozinho a cada turno seu na: The game saves automatically on each of your turns in matches against the AI, on the same device and in the campaign. Use "Continue match" at the top of the menu to pick up where you left off.
Abra uma sala e passe o código (ex.: K7M: Open a room and share the code (e.g. K7M-2QP) or the invite. The host sets up the teams and can let players ask to team up. There is chat, spectators and, if someone drops, they have 2 minutes to come back before the AI takes over.
Nas missões com pelo menos duas Warmachi: On missions with at least two Warmachines, "Co-op over the network" splits the units between you and a friend; the turn passes when both end it.
Em Configurações → Perfil, escolha seu n: In Settings → Profile, choose your name and a photo (PNG, JPG or GIF up to 20 MB). They appear in matches, also for other players, along with your statistics.
No fim de uma partida avulsa, \"Salvar r: At the end of a skirmish, "Save replay" stores the match to watch later. Skirmishes have optional fog of war, and the map generator has test victory modes. Developer mode (damage preview) is in Settings and does not count toward progress.
